relationships.subject: ST36 acupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: ST36 acupuncture reduced TXNIP expression, inhibited the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome

relationships.subject: TXNIP
relationships.evidence_quote: Interference with TXNIP alleviated the behavior disorders and inhibited NLRP3, caspase 1, and IL-1β levels.

key_findings: ST36 acupuncture decreased TXNIP, NLRP3, caspase-1 and IL-1β and improved behavior in VPA autism rats
